User Story: As a pharmacist, I want to register a medicine batch with batch number, quantity, and expiry date so that inventory records remain accurate.
As a pharmacist, I want to view medicine batches and their available quantities so that I can monitor stock.
As a pharmacist, I want to see expired and near-expiry batches so that I can prevent expired medicine from being dispensed.
As a pharmacist, I want the system to prioritize the earliest-expiring valid batch so that stock is issued safely and waste is reduced.
As an inventory manager, I want the system to flag medicines below their reorder threshold so that replenishment can start on time.
As an inventory manager, I want to create a purchase order draft for low-stock medicines so that restocking is easier to coordinate.
As an inventory manager, I want to update and view purchase-order and dispatch status so that I can track replenishment.
